CustomField.description: User object field for capturing users that have an approved and completed PeopleSoft Role for Quick Text Manager.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check this box when a user is granted Quick Text Manager. Note, even though this field is in this "Salesforce PeopleSoft Roles" section, there is no PeopleSoft role for this. Access is provided by granting the "Quick Text Manager" permission set.
CustomField.label: Quick Text Manager
